import os
import tempfile
import shutil
import pytest

from doorstop.core.document import Document, Item
from doorstop.core.types import Level
from doorstop.common import DoorstopError
from doorstop.core import importer


@pytest.fixture
def temp_doc(tmp_path):
    """Create a temporary Doorstop document in a fresh directory."""
    doc_path = tmp_path / "doc"
    doc_path.mkdir()
    # Initialise an empty document
    doc = Document.new(doc_path)
    yield doc
    # Clean up
    shutil.rmtree(tmp_path, ignore_errors=True)


def test_U01_2_Gherkin_BDD___TC_001(temp_doc):
    """Unique Identifier - Single Section"""
    doc = temp_doc
    # Create a single section
    item = doc.add_item(level=Level(1))
    uid = item.uid
    # Link the section (in Doorstop a link is just the uid)
    linked_uid = uid
    # Assertions
    assert uid is not None, "UID should be assigned"
    assert linked_uid == uid, "Linked UID should match the item's UID"


def test_U01_2_Gherkin_BDD___TC_002(temp_doc):
    """Unique Identifier - Multiple Sections (1)"""
    doc = temp_doc
    count = 1
    uids = set()
    for _ in range(count):
        item = doc.add_item(level=Level(1))
        uids.add(item.uid)
    assert len(uids) == count, "Each section should have a unique UID"


def test_U01_2_Gherkin_BDD___TC_003(temp_doc):

def test_U01_2_Gherkin_BDD___TC_006(temp_doc):
    """Store Valid Asset"""
    doc = temp_doc
    # Create a dummy asset file
    asset_name = "test.pdf"
    asset_path = doc.path / asset_name
    asset_path.write_text("dummy pdf content")
    # Copy asset into document's assets folder
    doc.copy_assets([asset_path])
    # Verify asset stored
    stored_path = doc.assets / asset_name
    assert stored_path.exists(), "Asset should be stored in document assets"
    # Retrieve by name
    retrieved = doc.assets / asset_name
    assert retrieved.read_text() == "dummy pdf content", "Asset content should match"


def test_U01_2_Gherkin_BDD___TC_007(temp_doc):
    """Store Invalid Asset"""
    doc = temp_doc
    # Create an unsupported asset file
    asset_name = "test.exe"
    asset_path = doc.path / asset_name
    asset_path.write_text("dummy exe content")
    # Attempt to copy asset; expect DoorstopError
    with pytest.raises(DoorstopError):
        doc.copy_assets([asset_path])
